mission.goal: Full 30-year Ottawa run (262920 h) of ecosys-ng with zero science gap against legacy Fortran (f77src/) and scientifically comparable outputs
mission.duration_expectation: multi-month autonomous operation, cycle after cycle, no artificial stopping gate

owns: diagnosis of divergences and solver failures
architecture decisions, DEV-NNN and legacy-inconsistency decisions (with the evidence discipline in protocol.md §6)
final scientific review of its own cycle against gates G1–G9
commit and push of every completed cycle

subagents.role: optional swarm of fresh-context helpers; never co-owners, never authorities
forbidden: starting full or bounded simulation runs (analysis of existing run output only)
repeating a full-run benchmark the parent already owns
subagents.when_mandatory: gate G7: any change to process equations/parameters, solver formulation, bounds/floors, acceptance/rollback logic, restart/output semantics, architecture, any DEV, or a hard solver rung (S4/S5/S8/S9)
subagents.resource_note: record available RAM; cap concurrent sub-agent builds; sub-agents never run full campaigns

cycle.on_gate_failure: fix, or revert the diff and record the negative result; never commit a gate-failing diff to main

gates.G1_build: touched code builds clean in Debug + ReleaseSafe with Zig 0.17.x (a 0.16 build is not current evidence); production runs use ReleaseFast
gates.G2_regressions: zig build test + uv run pytest ecosys-audit/tests -q pass; new discriminating test with each fix
gates.G3_conservation: local and global water, heat, C, N, P ledgers close at every accepted hour
gates.G4_traceability: every physics change cites f77src file:line; every touched guard matches the legacy floor in value, scale, operator, units, placement
gates.G5_parity: affected production outputs compared against the legacy oracle with units and time semantics
gates.G6_forbidden_diff: no tolerance loosening, no post-solve clamps, no unregistered DEV-NNN, no ceiling or iteration raise without legacy justification, no silent retries, no new unreachable
gates.G7_independent_verification: fresh-context verifier sub-agent re-derives the decisive gates from diff + legacy ranges + receipts only; a reproduced FAIL means fix or revert
gates.G8_sync: cycle committed and pushed; git rev-parse HEAD and origin/main equal
gates.G9_containment: every input and output of this cycle's commands (sources, caches, temp files, checkpoints, run output, logs) stayed inside the repository root

sync.on_push_failure: keep the commit, set cycle.json sync_status=PENDING, note it in state.md, retry at next cycle start, never stack more than one unpushed cycle

rules: never paste raw logs or whole source files into prompts, cycle files or sub-agent briefs
cite file:line and short sha256; store bulky artifacts under audit/runs/ and cite receipt.json
use f77query.py / bindcheck.py and narrow ripgrep instead of bulk reads of 10k-line Fortran units

lanes.note: the single agent has one write lane covering all of the above except read_only; the lanes exist to keep sub-agent briefs and diff scans honest

prohibitions: loosening tolerances or raising iteration/step ceilings to make a failure pass
publishing a non-converged state whose ledger does not close
new publish-best-bounded deviations (DEV-009/011/014/015 family is debt to retire)
committing a cycle whose recorded gates are missing or failed

continuity.session_end: write state.md (frontier, live run, open threads, next target), push, then stop
continuity.loop_breaker: same command/edit/error 3x, or re-reads with no new finding, or oscillating edits: stop, log attempts in the cycle file, spawn a fresh-context diagnose sub-agent, take the narrowest remaining step; two consecutive stalls on one target -> split it into two cycles
continuity.context_discipline: commit + push + update state.md and start a fresh session instead of degrading at high context use
continuity.backoff: record the blocker and the check that clears it in .agent/backlog.md, then take the next unblocked item; stop only for human-only conditions (credentials, destructive ops, spending)
continuity.stale_recovery: remove stale .agent/locks/* with a note; reconcile a mid-status cycle.json against git log and the cycle file; resume a dead run from its last checkpoint
continuity.long_runs: detached background process, log path recorded in state.md, never two concurrent runs of the same case
continuity.pickup_preflight: uv run ecosys-audit/scripts/preflight.py (Zig pin + containment + sync + cycle status)

legacy_files..agent/adversarial/: worker/judge round records: science history, no authority
legacy_files..agent/workflow.json: retired swarm-controller ledger, kept as history
legacy_files..agent/dispatch.json: retired swarm dispatch state, kept as history
legacy_files..agent/current_task.md: retired swarm task pointer, kept as history
legacy_files.archive/pre-solo-workflow/: retired launchers, judge-gated runner, poke tooling
legacy_files.ecosys-audit/scripts/swarm_wrapper.py: optional Herdr peer-agent controller, not part of this protocol

toolchain.ecosys_ng: Zig 0.17.x only (Debug + ReleaseSafe for gates, ReleaseFast for production runs)
toolchain.retired: Zig 0.16 — its receipts are dated history and cannot close a current gate

workspace_containment.rule: all work stays inside this repository: investigation, edits, builds, tests, runs, staging, caches, checkpoints, downloads, logs and evidence. Nothing a later cycle needs to reproduce may live outside.

caches.zig_flags_note: Zig 0.17: `zig build` rejects --global-cache-dir (measured 2026-10-12, audit/runs/zig017-pin017-debug-20261012); the global cache is set by ZIG_GLOBAL_CACHE_DIR. Direct compiler calls (zig build-exe) still take it.

allowed_outside_read_only: the machine's installed toolchain and system libraries
